newsitem.title: ITALY: Flower-loving grandmother grows opium at home.
newsitem.headline: Flower-loving grandmother grows opium at home.

text.p: An Italian grandmother with a penchant for flowers was charged with narcotics possession on Tuesday when police found opium plants in her garden.

Police said the woman, 80, who was not named, began ripping up some of the 13 plants when she saw the police. The plants, each about 1.5 metres (five feet) tall, were verified as opium plants at Rome's botanical gardens.
The woman said someone had given her the seeds as a gift and she planted them because she loved flowers.
